ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (near-black) field across roughly 95% of the fluke surface, punctuated by high-intensity (white) pixel clusters comprising approximately 5% of the visible area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discontinuous high-contrast white annular and circular geometric blobs scattered across the dark pixel field of both the left and right lobes, with higher frequency of clusters toward the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped central depression with an obtuse interior angle estimated at approximately 130-140 degrees and a relatively shallow vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary showing low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge, with increased amplitude and irregular spacing at the distal extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a wide, shallow concave arc from the median notch before transitioning to a convex curve near the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated spatial clusters of white circular and 'O' shaped ring marks of varying diameters distributed throughout the dark pigmentation of the ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scars) oriented diagonally across the right lobe, appearing as faint high-intensity breaks in the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface scarring consisting of circular white patterns (rosettes) consistent with historical barnacle colonization; no gross structural amputations or trailing edge notches beyond normal serration are visible.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific density and overlapping configuration of annular white scars provides a unique textural signature on the dark pixel background.
